name: qingwu-web-clipper
description: 青梧 Web Clipper - 面向青梧 AI 编辑器的现代化浏览器剪藏插件（Chrome / Edge / Firefox）

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build --config vite.config.content.ts && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.build:chrome: cross-env TARGET=chrome vite build && cross-env TARGET=chrome vite build --config vite.config.content.ts && node scripts/build.mjs chrome
scripts.build:firefox: cross-env TARGET=firefox vite build && cross-env TARGET=firefox vite build --config vite.config.content.ts && node scripts/build.mjs firefox
scripts.build:edge: cross-env TARGET=edge vite build && cross-env TARGET=edge vite build --config vite.config.content.ts && node scripts/build.mjs edge
scripts.release: npm run build && node scripts/build.mjs package
scripts.release:chrome: npm run build:chrome && node scripts/build.mjs package chrome
scripts.release:firefox: npm run build:firefox && node scripts/build.mjs package firefox
scripts.release:edge: npm run build:edge && node scripts/build.mjs package edge
